boundedQuestion: Does the packaged source-first freeze guard make the PASS receipt atomic with the frozen native module, including the interval after the final module hash check and before receipt write?

independentReplayBoundary.reason: The delivered package does not include current/qa/reference_observe.py or its source asset closure, so the original 324-coordinate source query cannot be independently rerun from the archive alone.
independentReplayBoundary.whatWasTested: The unchanged packaged new-source.py receipt ordering, with a verifier-only deterministic source adapter in an isolated copy.

negativeTrial.mutation: Append a verifier-only comment to panel-mother.mjs only after new-source.py completes its second module hash loop and enters TeacherObservation.assert_unchanged(), but before NEW_SOURCE_QA.json is written.

positiveControl.action: Restore panel-mother.mjs exactly to the frozen SHA and rerun the same 324-row plan with no concurrent write.

rootCause: new-source.py performs the last frozen-module hash assertion before calling r.assert_unchanged(), then writes the receipt afterward. The validation and publication are separate operations; there is no immutable snapshot, lock, staged receipt bound to post-write hashes, or atomic compare-and-commit.

candidateRule.verifierGate: A validation receipt must be generated from an immutable snapshot or committed with an atomic compare-and-commit. Re-hash every frozen input and the staged receipt immediately before an atomic rename/commit; any mismatch must delete or quarantine the staged receipt and exit nonzero. A PASS file written after the last identity check is not authoritative.
candidateRule.minimumTrial: On one A4 Mother only, pause after the final validation check, mutate one frozen input byte, and require nonzero exit with no authoritative PASS receipt; exact restore must pass the same plan.

boundaries: Does not reject the two-inset geometry, native D1/C0 results, software-GLES output, or the archived pristine source metrics.
Does not prove the archived first failure was fabricated; it shows the present script does not close every concurrent-write timing window.
Does not certify the original source query because its source adapter and source asset are absent from the package.
Candidate applies first to this A4 source-first receipt path; no global OS change is adopted.
